title: DIO measured-substrate revenue foundation
purpose: Bind a customer request, quote, accepted work, and delivery to exact Muhlnickel and artifact evidence without turning payment metadata into proof.

lifecycle.settled_by: quote.status == ACCEPTED, quote.accepted_work is present, and quote.bazaar.action_id is non-null
delivery_receipt.schema.json plus byte and acceptance evidence

payment_contract.note: Payment is external metadata only. NOT_REQUESTED requires a null reference; every other status requires a nonempty external reference. No status invokes a rail, and no reference proves delivery.

invariants: Every lifecycle record contains measured substrate provenance.
Accepted work is an accepted quote with a named Bazaar action.
DELIVERED requires a quote, PASS acceptance, artifacts, Bazaar action/result IDs, a result address, and substrate provenance; MEASURED permits honest null lineage.
Null remains null when an input, Bazaar ID, amount, or settlement reference does not exist.
These records describe work; they do not restrict Commons participation or Action Pad capability.
